title: Dying Wish
label: Echoes of the Infinite
shareDescription: Declay's 'Dying Wish' lands on Echoes of the Infinite on November 27. The imprint's third transmission. Sound without boundaries.
body: 'Dying Wish' is the third transmission on Echoes of the Infinite and the first from an artist other than BURKO. Declay arrives with a run of singles behind him across house, techno and trance, and brings that range into the darker, more emotional space the label was built to explore.

The imprint has always been about a feeling rather than a genre, and 'Dying Wish' is the first proof that the signal carries beyond its founder. Out November 27. Pre-add it now so it lands in your library the moment it drops.
